creator: Anonymous
model: Squared-distance Gromov-Wasserstein objective Q(pi) = E[(|X - X'|^2 - |Y - Y'|^2)^2] between Gaussian (or, for Theorem 3, general finite-fourth-moment) probability measures on Euclidean spaces of possibly different dimensions; Q_* is the unrestricted minimum over couplings and Q_G the minimum over jointly Gaussian couplings.

definitions.Q_G: minimum of Q over jointly Gaussian couplings, = 4(alpha - beta)^2 + 8|a - b|^2 for zero-padded sorted spectra a, b with traces alpha, beta (Delon et al. 2022)
definitions.proportional spectra: equal positive rank and ordered positive eigenvalues in a constant ratio

claims.statement: Two Gaussian measures of positive covariance rank admit a jointly Gaussian unrestricted optimiser of Q if and only if their positive ranks agree and their ordered positive covariance eigenvalues are proportional (equivalently Q_* = Q_G). In particular the conjecture of Delon, Desolneux and Salmona fails for every other pair, including pairs of equal dimension.
claims.scope: All means and ambient dimensions; sufficiency is due to Delon et al. (2022), necessity is the proposed contribution.

claims.statement: If the source has finite fourth moment and support with nonempty relative interior in its affine hull, an affine map is GW-optimal onto its image if and only if it is a similarity or a constant.
claims.scope: Squared-distance objective; the four-point example shows that finite supports can escape the conclusion.

claims.statement: An explicit pair flow preserves the standard Gaussian, and its first variation gives the maximal Gaussian-preserving slope of the objective at the common-latent coupling; it strictly improves the Gaussian benchmark whenever the zero-padded spectra are not proportional.
With zero-padded eigenvalue lists a, b and S = |a|^2|b|^2 - (a.b)^2, the Gaussian excess D = Q_G - Q_* satisfies S/(|a||b|) <= D <= 8(|a||b| - a.b).
claims.scope: Lower bound new; upper bound due to Delon et al. (2022). Sharper pair-specific certificates in Sections 6.1-6.2.

claims.statement: Q_G/2 <= Q_* <= Q_G for all Gaussian pairs of positive covariance rank, and the constant 1/2 is approached by nearly isotropic spectra in high dimension.
claims.scope: Upper half immediate from the known upper bound; sharpness family checked numerically for d in {2, 5, 50, 500}.

claims.statement: A comonotone integral M_co gives a refinement of the known upper bound on the excess.
claims.scope: The plane-to-line value M_co = 4.79528... is evaluated numerically (two independent high-precision methods), not as an interval enclosure.

claims.statement: GW between finite-fourth-moment measures is stable under perturbation (triangle inequality and stability), and the plug-in Gaussian formula evaluated at sample covariances is an inconsistent estimator of the population GW value between nonproportional Gaussians.
claims.scope: Population and almost-sure limit statement; no finite-sample rates.

claims.statement: Plane to line (N(0, I_2) to N(0, 1)): the Gaussian value is 12; an explicit coupling has objective below 76/7 (proved; about 10.47 numerically); 12 - 8(sqrt 2 - 1) = 8.6863 <= Q_* <= 12 - 4/(1 + sqrt 6) = 10.8404 (proved).
claims.scope: Numerical couplings reach about 10.03 and a numerically evaluated lower refinement gives about 8.82; these are not certified enclosures.
